answer: Mechanism: replay-bond admission. Each agent posts a bond sized by its age in the basalt ledger, an append-only record: fresh identities pay a costly cold-start bond, decaying only after randomized replay audits - a sampled session must re-derive its stored trace. Failure burns the bond; each burned unit, an ember, funds a garden reserve for honest auditors. N puppets each face independent audits and pay full replay compute, no batch discount. Reset restarts cold, since history binds to the basalt record, not the key. Per-sybil cost: one bond plus linear replay work.
